offering_description.value: Provides in-home personal care, home health and hospice services to elderly and disabled people, mostly funded by government programs. Delivers care through its own local branch offices and employs caregivers and nurses who visit clients at home.

primary_services.value: personal care; homemaker services; home health nursing; hospice care; therapy services

customer_segment.value: B2G: state Medicaid agencies and waiver programs, Veterans Affairs; B2B: managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, hospices and health systems

end_markets.value: healthcare; aging and long-term care; disability services

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicaid, Medicare and managed care payments for in-home care visits

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers in-home care using its own caregivers, sold to state programs and managed care plans

geography_served.value: US national: about two dozen states, concentrated in the Midwest, South and Northeast

specialization.value: related lines: personal care, home health nursing and hospice services sharing the same clients and payers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: local branch offices that schedule and supervise in-home caregivers; direct sales: contracts negotiated directly with state agencies and managed care organizations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state home care licensure and Medicare/Medicaid certification, overseen by CMS and state health departments
